title: fix: defer offscreen chat text attachment reads
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where scrolling attachment-heavy chat history resolves metadata and downloads pasted-text excerpts for notes far outside the viewport.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing attachment admission directive observes the actual text chip and the identities in a comment group. Authorization and source resolution stay with the existing renderer; bounded body reads stay with the preview components.

Follow-up to [PR 155623](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/155623). Inline audio/video, SVG previews, video posters, ticket lifetimes, cache policy, and composer behavior are unchanged. The integration preserves current attachment filenames, source/gallery behavior, and the composer remove action.

## User Impact

History pasted-text and grouped comment chips load their details near the viewport or when focused. Keyboard focus stays on the same chip while metadata loads. Comment bodies still load only when the preview is revealed; composer attachments keep their current behavior.

## Evidence

- Integrated head: `dc696ebc054962395ed0e177ec0fe7bf82a3298b`, based on frozen main `2dd93a290b748686160b4a478b7ee003cc0f9f24`; eight scoped files, no dependency or authorization change.
- [Remote integration proof](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36968063494): **37/37** admission, attachment, and gallery unit cases; **1/1** selected filename/download regression (102 other cases intentionally filtered); **2/2** real Chromium native-Tab cases. Exact source and 34 relevant inputs matched. These 40 passing cases are retained without replay because the candidate is unchanged.
- The Chromium cases hold metadata responses and verify focus remains on the same chip. Their body responses resolve immediately; this is not proof of focus across a separately held body response, a deployed app, or an authenticated live Gateway.
- The initial changed-check leg used an older transport base and failed the line-cap ratchet on unrelated main changes. The corrected exact-base, eight-path check continuation timed out in Testbox admission before executing. No completed-check claim is made: full check/build/test qualification must come from successful required CI on this published head before native preparation and merge.
- Fresh whole-diff independent review found no actionable P0-P2 findings. Normal exact-head required CI remains the landing gate.

### Historical Before/After Evidence

The original six entry-point regressions failed before the repair. Synthetic actual-renderer Chromium captures reduced initial metadata reads from **13 to 1**, with explicit keyboard Open verified. These captures predate the current-main integration and are not new live measurements.

![Before: thirteen initial metadata reads](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/daed7927-fe35-4285-a577-2e8bc00163f5)

![After: one initial metadata read, same visible text attachment](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a530c017-69b0-4324-ba57-12eee28af8d1)
